tasks.label: Stop: App background processes
args: $workspace = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath('${workspaceFolder}').TrimEnd('\'); $client = Join-Path $workspace 'client'; $serverExe = Join-Path $workspace 'target\debug\virtual-cinema-server.exe'; $appProcesses = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { ($_.Name -ieq 'virtual-cinema-server.exe' -and $_.ExecutablePath -and $_.ExecutablePath -ieq $serverExe) -or ($_.Name -ieq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine.IndexOf($client, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -and $_.CommandLine -match '(?i)node_modules[\\/]vite[\\/]') }); if ($appProcesses.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output 'No Threater backend or Vite processes are running.'; exit 0 }; foreach ($process in $appProcesses) { Write-Output "Stopping $($process.Name) (PID $($process.ProcessId))"; Stop-Process -Id $process.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $remaining = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { ($_.Name -ieq 'virtual-cinema-server.exe' -and $_.ExecutablePath -and $_.ExecutablePath -ieq $serverExe) -or ($_.Name -ieq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine.IndexOf($client, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -and $_.CommandLine -match '(?i)node_modules[\\/]vite[\\/]') }); if ($remaining.Count -gt 0) { Write-Error "Could not stop matching Threater process IDs: $($remaining.ProcessId -join ', ')"; exit 1 }; Write-Output 'Threater backend and Vite processes stopped.'
